sources.title: GitHub - morawi/FashionColor-0: Color extraction from clothing items
sources.snippet: FashionColor-0 Color extraction from clothing images. Color modelling and extraction is an important topic in fashion. It can help build a wide range of applications, for example, recommender systems, color-based retrieval, fashion design, etc. We aim to develop and test models that can extract the dominant colors of clothing and accessory items.
